announcements.headline: US$1.36m Non-Exclusive Patent Licensing Agreement
announcements.insight: This non-exclusive licensing deal provides initial revenue validation for Ethernity's blockchain infrastructure but lacks the transformative scale of a major acquisition or significant capital raise; it signals commercial traction in the enterprise blockchain sector without materially altering the company's financial baseline.

announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies a scheduled release of financial performance data for the half-year period. Shareholders will gain visibility into the company's operational results and financial position during this timeframe.

announcements.headline: Patent monetisation process update
announcements.insight: Monetising IP assets provides a non-dilutive revenue stream for a cash-burning tech firm, signaling potential liquidity relief without immediate equity issuance, though execution risk remains high in the current valuation environment.

announcements.headline: Results for the Year Ended 31 December 2025
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual results for the reporting period ending in December 2025. It provides shareholders with a comprehensive overview of the company's financial performance and operational progress over the full year.
